body: Semantic ifs from open models, on a 3090 at home. Independent; not affiliated with Jev or TypeSafe.
plain_description: **Make fast, structured decisions with open models, without waiting for a generated answer.** Supply a state, criteria, and options to get probabilities for each option. Run the browser demo or use the Python scoring tools.
technical_description: SemIf reads typed option probabilities directly from open language models for runtime-defined decisions. It supports Python scoring with CUDA, Apple Silicon MPS and MLX, or CPU via llama.cpp and local GGUF checkpoints. A browser demo runs models with WebGPU. Includes state reuse, calibration, benchmarks, and reproducible evaluation artifacts.
title: SemIf
